headline: Dubai Islamic Bank Shares Jump 11% on Potential Emirates NBD Merger Talks
summary: Dubai Islamic Bank shares surged 11% following news that its board will meet alongside Emirates NBD to evaluate a potential merger.
why: Dubai Islamic Bank and Emirates NBD are among the largest financial institutions in the United Arab Emirates by asset size.

impacts.name: Dubai Islamic Bank
impacts.why: Dubai Islamic Bank shares jumped 11% on merger speculation.
